item.title: Delta Air Lines to Order 30 Boeing 787 Dreamliners
item.description: Delta’s latest order is an unusual one for the carrier — the only Boeing widebody in its fleet is the 767, a much older aircraft. After experiencing a slew of safety and quality issues over the past few years, the order also signals renewed confidence in Boeing’s turnaround efforts.

item.title: Wizz Air Wants Premium Passengers – Without the Business Class Fuss
item.description: Wizz Air is testing how far it can push “premium” without touching the cost or complexity of business class. If blocked seats and basic perks lift yields with little operational pain, this won’t stay a niche product for long.

item.title: Delta Sees More Consumer and Business Demand in 2026
item.description: Delta is reporting a strong start to the year, despite a rocky 2025 that saw airlines pull guidance and cancel flights due to the government shutdown.

item.title: Premier Inn Owner on Activist Challenge: ‘We Are Open-Minded’
item.description: Premier Inn's owner said it's considering a strategy shift in response to criticisms by activist investor Corvex. But it may not reveal any changes until its next financial update in April.

item.title: More Mergers, More Activist Investors: Delta Execs See a Shakeup for Low-Cost Airlines
item.description: Delta executives expect a lift to their main cabin revenues as low-cost carriers continue to struggle.

item.title: Trump’s 10% Credit Card Cap Would ‘Upend’ Industry, Delta CEO Says
item.description: Delta CEO Ed Bastian was highly skeptical of Trump’s proposal to implement a 10% cap on credit card interest rates. The proposal was also met with criticism from banks and Republican leadership.

item.title: U.S. Passport Trails 37 Countries, Losing Visa-Free Access to 7 Destinations
item.description: Although the U.S. has a top-10 passport ranking again, its increasingly tougher entry rules suggest a country moving against the global openness trend.

item.title: Google Is Siri’s New Brain. But Who Will Control the Travel Booking?
item.description: Embedding Gemini in Siri moves Google closer to the moment of intent — but Apple’s privacy architecture could cap how far that intelligence can act. Travel may be the clearest test of those limits.

item.title: Announcing Skift Asia Forum 2026: Strategy, Growth, and Leadership in Asia Travel
item.description: Skift Asia Forum returns to Bangkok this April, convening senior leaders who are actively making growth, partnership, and transformation decisions across Asia’s travel ecosystem.

item.title: India’s Travel Startup Funding Is No Longer Just About Online Travel Agencies
item.description: These fundings reflect a broader trend: For India’s travel startup ecosystem, capital infusion is no longer about scale alone, but about where value is being created in the travel stack.
